runtime_identity_basis: Runner manifest retains preparation-time actual visible GUI observation and process liveness, not continuous effective-state API truth. Metrics worker did not control or independently view the application.

inspection.method: Actual assistant inspection of exact immutable raw OSC payloads, supplied prepared English source, and app-owner GUI metadata; not human validation or semantic-quality scoring.
inspection.observed_payload_format: A source-only English payload is followed by source newline Japanese translation. Six translated observations inspected each expose source and translation on separate lines.

source_only_example.text: Good that we've got pockets today.
source_only_example.role: retained nontranslation observation, excluded from translation denominator

bounded_translation_addition.same_source: Good that we've got pockets today.
bounded_translation_addition.added_translation: 今日はポケットがあって良かったです。
bounded_translation_addition.interpretation: Observed source-only to bilingual update, not evidence that all later messages revise one group. The source-only parent is outside the translation-output graph.

measured_outputs.basis: First measured output; exact distinct source unit .16 rather than preceding reference-free check phrase 'right now'.

measured_outputs.source: I think that I would have to say
measured_outputs.translation: そう言わざるを得ないと思います
measured_outputs.basis: Related partial content from .17; source correspondence does not prove message-group/revision/final-display relationship.
Related partial content from .17; do not infer append or revision solely from the shared source sentence.

rule.uncertainty: Bounded newline extraction from this exact GUI pilot only. Global update/pagination/resend/finality relationships unsupported; ambiguous content-change-dependent metrics remain N/A. Source-only update evidence retained separately.

limits: One configuration and one original development session, not a campaign or cross-app conclusion.
An exposed source fragment aids correspondence but does not certify translation accuracy or complete delivery of sentence meaning.
